The build passes and the test is green. Note the specific test (`coreRejectionIsProblemJson`) removes `city`, which is `@NotNull`, so it actually flows through the bean-validation `MethodArgumentNotValidException` handler (400) — which now emits `application/problem+json` too.

## Summary

All rejection responses (400, 409, 429) now return an RFC7807 `application/problem+json` body with `type`, `title`, `status`, and `detail`; status codes are unchanged.

**Changes:**

1. **`RestApiRejectionException.java`** (new) — a `RuntimeException` carrying an `HttpStatus` + detail message. Controllers throw this to reject a request instead of returning a bare status.

2. **`ExceptionControllerAdvice.java`**
